title: Uruguayan Brussels Sprouts Pilaf
description: A flavorful Chinese-inspired pilaf dish featuring Uruguayan sprouts, perfect as a side or main course.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the halved Brussels sprouts and cook for 5 minutes, until they start to brown.
Add the uncooked rice to the skillet and stir to combine with the sprouts and garlic.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, until the rice is lightly toasted.
Add the soy sauce, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 20-25 minutes, until the rice is cooked and the sprouts are tender.
Remove from the oven and fluff the pilaf with a fork. Serve hot.
